scope: Design documentation, conceptual SVG map and narrow source-contract lint; no gameplay or production asset modifications
environment: Linux, Python 3.12.14 standard library; pinned GitHub source snapshot

narrative_regression_tests.mutation_tests: In-memory negative cases for extra appearance stage, direct calm/completion/victory, HP counter, Sense purification, missing source/reset, changed progress and chapter transitions

document_structure.scope: JSON parsing, SVG XML parsing, workflow YAML parsing and internal links

map_layout_review.scope: SVG rasterization and geometry reviewed; Japanese glyph rendering unverified because the local renderer has no Japanese font. Deliverable remains UTF-8 SVG with browser font fallbacks.

all_existing_python_tests.reason: Focused stdlib suite only; pytest and full asset/tool fixture set were not provisioned

limitations: Text-based source contracts are not C++ compilation or runtime proof.
Human review remains necessary for story prose, source semantics, binary assets, actor counts, delegates, visuals, sound and accessibility.
The Early/Advanced contract is design data, not a newly implemented material-switch system.
